-- Deviation: the stock FCF_ChatTabFadeFinished (FloatingChatFrame.lua:989-992) nils -- oldAlpha even under a live hover, so leaving and re-entering within -- CHAT_FRAME_FADE_TIME (a flick to the scroll buttons, outside the hover box, does it) -- stops the plate fading in (l.873) for the rest of the session; this keeps oldAlpha while -- hover is set because the stock one nils it even under a live hover. if FCF_ChatTabFadeFinished then function FCF_ChatTabFadeFinished(chatTab, chatFrame) chatTab:Hide() if not chatFrame.hover then chatFrame.oldAlpha = nil end end end
-- Deviation: re-runs UIParent_ManageFramePositions after DurabilityFrame's own OnEvent. The -- pass seats the frame 20 further in while a side glyph shows (UIParent.lua:1759-1768); a -- glyph appearing while the frame is shown leaves the shield's overhang off the screen edge -- because the stock frame runs it only from OnShow/OnHide. The stock handler runs first, -- unchanged, on the this/event/arg1 already set for the dispatch. if DurabilityFrame then local refOnEvent = DurabilityFrame:GetScript("OnEvent") DurabilityFrame:SetScript("OnEvent", function() if refOnEvent then refOnEvent() end UIParent_ManageFramePositions() end) end
-- Deviation: friendly plates the player turned on come back at every world entry; the stock -- UpdateNameplates (UIOptionsFrame.lua:768-780) shows them and hides them again -- at once (l.775-776), and FRIENDNAMEPLATES_ON is never saved because l.182 registers -- NAMEPLATES_ON a second time. function UpdateNameplates() if ( NAMEPLATES_ON ) then ShowNameplates() else HideNameplates() end if ( FRIENDNAMEPLATES_ON ) then ShowFriendNameplates() else HideFriendNameplates() end end RegisterForSave("FRIENDNAMEPLATES_ON")
-- Deviation: a button whose key moved away keeps the old key's label while it holds an -- action with no range (a stance, a self buff) because the stock ActionButton_UpdateHotkeys -- (ActionButton.lua:129-140) writes no text in that one unbound case; this clears it. The -- stock function runs first, unchanged. local refUpdateHotkeys = ActionButton_UpdateHotkeys function ActionButton_UpdateHotkeys(actionButtonType) refUpdateHotkeys(actionButtonType) local action = (actionButtonType or "ACTIONBUTTON")..this:GetID() local button = ActionButton_GetPagedID(this) if ( GetBindingText(GetBindingKey(action), "KEY_", 1) == "" and HasAction(button) and not ActionHasRange(button) ) then getglobal(this:GetName().."HotKey"):SetText("") end end
-- Deviation: a character name is a required "First Last" pair, and the stock chat splits -- a whisper at the first word. `ChatEdit_ExtractTellTarget` (ChatFrame.lua:2210-2223) -- takes the word before the first space as the target and leaves the rest as the line, -- so `/w Asha Brightvale hi`, the chat link's `ChatFrame_SendTell` prefill -- (l.1606-1619) and the /who menu's Whisper row all addressed "Asha" with "Brightvale -- hi" as the message. This takes the two words a name has and the message from the -- third, replicating that branch (l.2212-2222) rather than handing stock a marker -- through GetText: `ChatEdit_AddHistory` (l.1924-1925) files `editBox.tellTarget`, so a -- marker there would be recalled into the box. -- -- A space pressed while only the first word is typed is the name's separator, not its -- end, so the line is left for the second word (`ChatEdit_OnSpacePressed`, l.1979-1981); -- a prefill from a menu or a link does not wait, and one-word lines still parse there as -- stock parses them. A send with one word runs the stock branch and sends nothing. local benillaIsSpacePressed = nil local benillaWhisperCommands = nil local function benillaIsWhisperCommand(command) if ( not benillaWhisperCommands ) then benillaWhisperCommands = {} local i = 1 local cmdString = TEXT(getglobal("SLASH_WHISPER"..i)) while ( cmdString ) do benillaWhisperCommands[strupper(cmdString)] = 1 i = i + 1 cmdString = TEXT(getglobal("SLASH_WHISPER"..i)) end end return benillaWhisperCommands[command] end
if ( ChatEdit_ParseText ) then local refParseText = ChatEdit_ParseText function ChatEdit_ParseText(editBox, send) local text = editBox:GetText() if ( strlen(text) > 0 and strsub(text, 1, 1) == "/" ) then -- The command and its message, split as the stock body does (l.2099-2105). local command = gsub(text, "/([^%s]+)%s(.*)", "/%1", 1) local msg = "" if ( command ~= text ) then msg = strsub(text, strlen(command) + 2) end command = strupper(gsub(command, "%s+", "")) if ( benillaIsWhisperCommand(command) ) then local first = gsub(msg, "^(%s*)([^%s]+)(.*)$", "%2") local last = "" local rest = nil if ( strlen(first) > 0 and strsub(first, 1, 1) ~= "|" ) then local afterFirst = strsub(msg, strlen(first) + 2) last = gsub(afterFirst, "^(%s*)([^%s]+)(.*)$", "%2") if ( strlen(last) > 0 and strsub(last, 1, 1) ~= "|" ) then rest = strsub(afterFirst, strlen(last) + 2) end end if ( rest ) then editBox.tellTarget = first.." "..last editBox.chatType = "WHISPER" editBox:SetText(rest) ChatEdit_UpdateHeader(editBox) return end if ( send == 0 and benillaIsSpacePressed ) then return end end end return refParseText(editBox, send) end
if ( ChatEdit_OnSpacePressed ) then local refOnSpacePressed = ChatEdit_OnSpacePressed function ChatEdit_OnSpacePressed() benillaIsSpacePressed = 1 refOnSpacePressed() benillaIsSpacePressed = nil end end end
-- Deviation: stock `SetItemRef` keeps only the last word of a player link's name (the two -- `gsub` passes at ItemRef.lua:6-7), from before names were pairs: the link is -- `player:First Last` (`ChatFrame.lua:1445-1451`), so click-to-whisper and its right-click -- menu addressed the wrong half. Its player branch (l.3-47) is the stock one, with the -- name read whole; every other link still runs the stock file's own body. if ( SetItemRef ) then local refSetItemRef = SetItemRef function SetItemRef(link, text, button) if ( strsub(link, 1, 6) == "player" ) then local name = strsub(link, 8); if ( name and (strlen(name) > 0) ) then if ( IsShiftKeyDown() ) then local staticPopup; staticPopup = StaticPopup_Visible("ADD_IGNORE"); if ( staticPopup ) then getglobal(staticPopup.."EditBox"):SetText(name); return; end staticPopup = StaticPopup_Visible("ADD_FRIEND"); if ( staticPopup ) then getglobal(staticPopup.."EditBox"):SetText(name); return; end staticPopup = StaticPopup_Visible("ADD_GUILDMEMBER"); if ( staticPopup ) then getglobal(staticPopup.."EditBox"):SetText(name); return; end staticPopup = StaticPopup_Visible("ADD_RAIDMEMBER"); if ( staticPopup ) then getglobal(staticPopup.."EditBox"):SetText(name); return; end if ( ChatFrameEditBox:IsVisible() ) then ChatFrameEditBox:Insert(name); else SendWho("n-"..name); end elseif ( button == "RightButton" ) then FriendsFrame_ShowDropdown(name, 1); else ChatFrame_SendTell(name); end end return; end return refSetItemRef(link, text, button); end end
